# EDUCBA

> > EDUCBA is a comprehensive online learning platform offering 5,000+ video courses, certifications, and training programs across Finance, Data Science, Excel, Design, and Business domains.

EDUCBA provides both free and premium learning pathways through SkillUP 101@FREE and EDUCBA Pro subscriptions, serving individual learners and enterprise teams. The platform combines self-paced video courses with certification programs designed for professional skill development.

## Core Learning Platform

- [EDUCBA Homepage](https://www.educba.com): Main landing page and entry point to EDUCBA's online training platform
- [EDUCBA Courses](https://www.educba.com/courses): Complete course catalog with 5,525+ practical certification training programs
- [Explore Courses](https://www.educba.com/explore): Course discovery and exploration interface for browsing EDUCBA offerings
- [EDUCBA Courses Directory](https://www.educba.com/educba-courses): Comprehensive course enrollment and learning program directory

## Subscription & Membership Plans

- [EDUCBA Pro](https://www.educba.com/educba-pro): Premium subscription providing access to 4,000+ courses with unlimited learning
- [PRO Bundles](https://www.educba.com/pro-bundles): Curated course package bundles and membership options for structured learning paths
- [SkillUP 101@FREE](https://www.educba.com/skillup-101free): Free skill-learning courses and training programs for budget-conscious learners

## Business & Enterprise Solutions

- [Enterprise Plans](https://www.educba.com/enterprise): Enterprise-grade solutions for team training, corporate enrollment, and business learning needs

## User Access & Community

- [Sign Up](https://www.educba.com/sign-up): User registration and account creation portal for accessing EDUCBA platform

## Educational Resources

- [EDUCBA Blog](https://www.educba.com/blog): Free educational content, knowledge-sharing articles, and learning resources library
